# `SEC_SECRET_ON_ARGV`

| | |
|---|---|
| Severity | warning |
| Area | [Security (`SEC_`)](README.md#domain-sec) |
| Reported by | `cli` |

## What happened

A secret was passed with `--header`/`--basic-auth`, where process lists and shell history can show it.

## What to do

Use an env variable or `holotype login` instead.
